description: Report how the workspace's Amazon offers stand for a buyer and what Amazon says is wrong with them. Per product linked to an Amazon listing: stage (active; search_suppressed = buyable but hidden from search, usually no main image; inactive = Seller Central's 'Non attivo'; suppressed = taken down by Amazon; missing = no offer under that SKU any more; null = never checked), action (fix_issues when Amazon reports an ERROR), issues (code, severity, message, the attributes involved, Amazon's enforcement such as SEARCH_SUPPRESSED), amazonSku (the seller SKU Amazon knows the offer by when it differs from the CRM SKU, e.g. a variation child linked by its barcode), the ASIN and when it was checked; plus a count per stage over the whole channel. Worst first, at most 100 rows. With refresh=true it asks Amazon first (a read; writes only the CRM's record of the answer). It never changes an offer: send photos and GPSR contacts with preview_amazon_listing_content then update_amazon_listing_content; the rest is fixed in Seller Central or on the product. Use list_channel_products for price and stock on the channel and check_channel_readiness for products not yet listed.

productIds.description: The products to report, at most 100 ids from search_products or list_channel_products. Omit for every product linked to an Amazon listing, worst first.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.

refresh.description: true asks Amazon now (summaries, issues, relationships) and records the answer before reporting; false reports what the CRM recorded on its last check, which runs hourly. Use true after the merchant fixed something in Seller Central.

name: inspect_amazon_listings
title: Inspect Amazon listings
